prompt: Pull the vendor name, invoice date and total from thousands of PDF invoices into a database.
tells: vendor name, invoice date and total
why: Content Understanding extracts named fields from documents.
trap: OCR gives all the text; you'd still have to find the fields.

prompt: Employees photograph receipts, and the app fills in merchant, amount and tax automatically.
tells: fills in merchant, amount and tax
why: Field extraction from a receipt image is Content Understanding.
trap: OCR reads characters; extraction returns the fields you defined.

prompt: Each insurance claim form has a policy number, incident date and a checkbox for injuries. Capture all three.
why: Content Understanding handles defined fields, including checkboxes, on forms.
trap: Checkbox state isn't text OCR can return as a field.

prompt: The team defines a schema of fields once, and every new contract is returned as JSON matching it.
why: A Content Understanding analyzer turns documents into structured output for a schema.
trap: Prompting a chat model for JSON is less reliable than a purpose-built analyzer.
